title: DSC 106 Project 1
description: The goal was to design a visualization that effectively communicates an idea about grocery store product data, and provide a short write-up about its design.

title: DSC 106 Project 2
description: Using a dataset, the task was to come up with a proposition and create two visuals, one supporting and one opposing the proposition. Deceptive techniques could be used, and they would be explained in a write-up.
